cases.purpose: A session survives its creating shell and kill waits for its owned descendant tree.
cases.oracle: The documented screen contract is checked against fixed child argv, independently inspected Linux process/tty state, exact geometric expectations, and private metadata snapshots; setup independently controls PTY winsize.
cases.comparison: The creator is a separate shell; list, state, relay status and procfs prove the named child survives it. Kill must remove the state tree and leave the recorded child, grandchild and broker not live; the guest checks all remaining strays. The tested kill and its raw return status are recorded before a separately logged, identity-checked fallback; fallback never changes the tested kill assertion.
cases.script:
export H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/terra-local-pty-screen-r3.py
export C=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/terra-local-pty-screen-cleanup-r3.py
export BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR=$HOME/screen-state
/usr/bin/mkdir -m 700 "$BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR" || exit 1
failed=0
mark() { if [[ $2 == 1 ]]; then printf '%s=PASS\n' "$1"; else printf '%s=FAIL\n' "$1"; failed=1; fi; }
await_file() { local j; for ((j=0;j<120;j++)); do [[ -f $HOME/$1 ]] && return 0; /usr/bin/sleep .05; done; return 1; }
fixture_cleanup() {
  if [[ -d $BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR/live ]]; then
    /usr/bin/python3 "$C" snapshot "$BASH" "$BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR" live "$HOME/screen-trap-before.json" 0 >>"$HOME/screen-cleanup.log" 2>&1 &&
      /usr/bin/python3 "$C" finish "$BASH" "$BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR" live "$HOME/screen-trap-before.json" "$HOME/screen-trap-cleanup.json" >>"$HOME/screen-cleanup.log" 2>&1 || :
  fi
  if [[ -f $HOME/lifecycle-before.json ]]; then
    /usr/bin/python3 "$C" finish-extra "$HOME/lifecycle-before.json" "$HOME/lifecycle-trap-cleanup.json" >>"$HOME/screen-cleanup.log" 2>&1 || :
  fi
  /usr/bin/python3 "$H" collect-sizes >>"$HOME/screen-cleanup.log" 2>&1 || :
}
trap fixture_cleanup EXIT

"$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c 'screen run -n live -d -- /usr/bin/python3 "$H" tree' >"$HOME/create.log" 2>"$HOME/errors.log"; create_rc=$?
await_file screen-child && await_file screen-grandchild || exit 1
child=$(<"$HOME/screen-child"); grand=$(<"$HOME/screen-grandchild")
listing=$(screen list 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"); list_rc=$?
state=$(screen state live 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"); state_rc=$?
relay=$(screen relay-status live 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"); relay_rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$state" >"$HOME/state-before.log"
printf '%s\n' "$relay" >"$HOME/relay-before.log"
broker=''; reported=''
if [[ $relay =~ broker[[:space:]]([0-9]+) ]]; then broker=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}; fi
if [[ $relay =~ child[[:space:]]([0-9]+) ]]; then reported=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}; fi
good=0; [[ $create_rc == 0 && $(<"$HOME/create.log") == live && $child =~ ^[0-9]+$ && $grand =~ ^[0-9]+$ && $broker =~ ^[0-9]+$ && $reported == "$child" && -e /proc/$child && -e /proc/$grand && $relay_rc == 0 && $relay == *'running 1'* ]] && good=1
mark ready-live-tree "$good"
good=0; [[ $list_rc == 0 && $listing == live && $state_rc == 0 && $state == *'session live'* && $state == *'backend ptybroker'* && -e /proc/$child ]] && good=1
mark survives-creator-exit "$good"
/usr/bin/python3 "$C" snapshot "$BASH" "$BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR" live "$HOME/screen-owned-before.json" 1 >>"$HOME/screen-cleanup.log" 2>&1 || exit 1
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/terra-local-pty-proc-r3.py snapshot-live "$HOME/lifecycle-before.json" broker "$broker" child "$child" grandchild "$grand" >>"$HOME/screen-cleanup.log" 2>&1 || exit 1
screen kill live >"$HOME/kill.log" 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"; kill_rc=$?
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/terra-local-pty-proc-r3.py snapshot "$HOME/lifecycle-after.json" broker "$broker" child "$child" grandchild "$grand" >>"$HOME/screen-cleanup.log" 2>&1 || exit 1
screen state live >"$HOME/state-after.log" 2>"$HOME/state-after.err"; state_after=$?
listing=$(screen list 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"); list_after=$?
good=0; if [[ $kill_rc == 0 && $state_after != 0 && $list_after == 0 && -z $listing && ! -e $BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR/live && $child =~ ^[0-9]+$ && $grand =~ ^[0-9]+$ && $broker =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && /usr/bin/python3 "$H" gone "$child" && /usr/bin/python3 "$H" gone "$grand" && /usr/bin/python3 "$H" gone "$broker"; then good=1; fi
mark kill-removes-services-and-descendants "$good"
printf "initial_kill_rc=%s state_after_rc=%s list_after_rc=%s\n" "$kill_rc" "$state_after" "$list_after" >"$HOME/kill-status.txt"
/usr/bin/python3 "$C" finish "$BASH" "$BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR" live "$HOME/screen-owned-before.json" "$HOME/screen-cleanup-after.json" >>"$HOME/screen-cleanup.log" 2>&1 || failed=1
/usr/bin/python3 "$C" finish-extra "$HOME/lifecycle-before.json" "$HOME/lifecycle-extra-cleanup.json" >>"$HOME/screen-cleanup.log" 2>&1 || failed=1
exit "$failed"
